replace_criteria.benchmark_note: With vision only, accept a physically meaningful aligned gripper downstroke into the intended button. Visible cap depression is strong but optional when the cap is occluded. Container changes never prove a press.
success_conditions: The gripper becomes aligned with and reaches the intended button rather than a nearby surface.

After reaching the button, the gripper visibly continues along the button's press direction into a sustained pressing pose; visible cap depression may confirm this but is not required under gripper occlusion.
insufficient_evidence: The gripper only approaches, hovers, or remains separated from the intended button.
There is brief overlap or ambiguous contact but no continued motion into the button and no sustained pressing pose.
Only withdrawal is visible without earlier aligned contact and downstroke in the recent sequence.
A container appears, disappears, moves, or changes occlusion.

required_checks.question: Ignoring every container event, does the recent sequence show the gripper aligned with and reaching the intended button rather than a nearby surface?

After reaching the intended button, does the gripper visibly continue along the press direction into it and reach a sustained pressing pose relative to the stationary button base? Visible cap depression is sufficient but not required when the gripper occludes the cap.

replace_criteria.unrelated_scene_policy: Container events may produce binding_updates but must not change either button-completion verdict.
